mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role (name, code, description, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{description}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE role SET name = #{name}, code = #{code}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1
SELECT p.* FROM permission p JOIN role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.status = 1
